# AcademicDevelopmentCoCreation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A process where academic staff jointly design and deliver professional development content, rather than receiving it from a central authority. Suggests a peer-driven, emergent governance model applicable to distributed control in TCC/iNEST networks.
